title: The Theranos Demo That Ran a "Null Protocol"

lines.say: Theranos promised a full range of blood tests from a single drop of blood.

scene.doc: THE VISION · AS QUOTED BY THE COURT

lines.say: At demonstrations, the appeals court wrote, VIP guests were led to believe the device was running their blood.

scene.kicker: THE DEMOS · PER THE NINTH CIRCUIT

lines.say: In reality, it was running a null protocol, while some samples were secretly run on other companies' machines.

scene.q: In reality, the device was running a “null protocol” while some of the VIP samples were surreptitiously run on third-party devices.

lines.say: The indictment said the null protocol was meant to make the analyzer appear to be operating.
According to prosecutors, the device itself could never run more than twelve types of tests.
lines.show: According to prosecutors, the device itself could never run more than 12 types of tests.

lines.say: Elizabeth Holmes was convicted of defrauding investors.
